faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Silan says, "Since I do not care to venture back to Leth Nurae to purchase from my usual supplier, I would appreciate it if you would procure me some frog skin plasma." "The liquid aspect of frog skin serves as an important emulsifier for a few arcane potions." "Your process is quite simple. Kill a frog , skin it, and crush the skin to extract the plasma. Mind you, only the dendrobian frogs to the south will yield the correct skins. Not every frog will have a good skin, either." [ edit ] Objectives Collect frog skin from dendrobian frogs found to the south of the Wardship. Crush the frog skin to produce frog skin plasma. Return with the plasma to Silan Maenian at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Frog Skin Plasma (14) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 7s 50c A choice from: Veil of Vitality Veil of Resitance Veil of Insight Veil of Might Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Frogs%2C_Freshly_Squeezed " Category : Thestra 31-35 Quests
